title: Builder Signals · 2026-11-28
summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 18 条 X 动态、1 集播客、0 篇博客；本站精选 9 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
featured.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie argues there is a huge opportunity right now to build new services firms from the ground up — or transform existing ones — with agents at the center. Domain expertise still matters because you need deep understanding to get the most out of agents, but delivery capacity now gets a 10X multiplier: happier clients, more wins, smaller customers previously outside the TAM, and outcomes that weren't conceivable before. He expects this in advertising, IT transformation, management consulting and finan…
featured.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 认为，现在是从零创办、或彻底改造以 Agent 为核心的服务型公司的窗口期。服务公司的领域专长依然关键——要把 Agent 用好仍需要深度行业理解——但交付能力被放大了 10 倍：可以让客户更满意、赢下更多客户、覆盖以前够不着的小客户，甚至交付过去无法想象的结果。他点名广告、IT 转型、管理咨询、财务等长期受制于人力产出速度的行业；也不看衰传统玩家，因为既有客户信任价值很大，但前提是必须迅速转型。

featured.title: Swyx · Latent Space / AI Engineer 创始人
featured.summaryEn: Swyx calls agentic payments one of the most divisive yet important themes to get right for 2028 — no in-between: either you get in early or you declare it's never going to happen. He also lays out why refounding in public works: critical feedback from people not paid to say yes, a human face on an otherwise corporate feel, and turning an "incumbent" into an "underdog" story; since 99% of customers never see your tweets, X is a relatively safe place to think in public as long as you stay inside the Overton window.…
featured.insightZh: Swyx 认为「Agentic 支付」是 2028 年最具争议、也最需要做对的主题之一——没有中间地带，要么早早入局，要么断言它永远不会发生。他还谈到「公开重塑（refound in public）」的好处：能拿到不是拿钱说好话的人的批评反馈、给公司加上人的面孔、把「在位者」叙事变成「挑战者」叙事；在他看来 X 对绝大多数客户而言「并不真实」，因此只要不越出主流共识边界，就是一个相对安全的公开思考空间。另外他还晒出某产品「首日就超过 Cursor 和 t3code」的成绩。

featured.title: The Revolution vs The Renaissance — Thariq Shihipar, OpenAI
featured.summaryEn: AI is both an industrial revolution and a renaissance. 2026 was the year of the software factory; what comes next is the renaissance of software — putting the human back into the feedback loop and using AI to raise quality and build personal, refined software rather than only chasing headless "dark factories." Recorded at the AIE Code Summit, this Latent Space episode features Thariq Shihipar, previously at Anthropic, who announced on the day of release that he is joining OpenAI (the hosts note Thibault and Andrew both framed it as time to "reinvent Codex"). His closing keynote covered what he got wrong this year: he was "Bash is all you need" and "React is all you need" pilled, but as models get smarter they also get wider and can work the way humans already work — even drawing a front end in Figma via computer use. The upshot is that humans can understand what models are doing, and th…
featured.insightZh: AI 同时是一场「工业革命」和一场「文艺复兴」——2026 年是软件工厂之年，接下来更值得关注的是软件的文艺复兴：把人重新放回反馈回路，用 AI 打磨个性化、高品质的软件，而不是只追求无人值守的「黑灯工厂」。 本期是 Latent Space 在 AIE Code Summit 录制的系列之一。嘉宾 Thariq Shihipar 此前在 Anthropic，录制当天宣布加入 OpenAI（据主持人介绍，Thibault 和 Andrew 都说这是「重新发明 Codex 的时候了」）。他是 AIE Code 的闭幕主讲人，主题是自己过去一年「看错了什么」：他曾非常信奉「Bash is all you need / 只要 CLI 不要 MCP」以及「React 会是终极语言」，但事实是模型越强越「宽」，能按人类既有的工作方式干活——甚至可以通过 computer use 直接在 Figma 里画前端。这意味着人可以理解模型在做什么，未来不必是模型循环产出一堆不可维护的代码。 他的核心主张是「设计构建软件的体验」。在做游戏时，他发现 vibe coding 会让模型做出很多自己不知道的假设，于是建了一个 /human 文件夹：里面是一种专门的脚本语言，lint 规则要求高密度注释、禁止单字符变量名、限制行长，让每个文件读起来像 spec，但又是真实可运行的代码——模型负责底层原语，他自己在上面调玩法。主持人总结：很多 slop 的产生正是因为人在构建过程中没有足够地 dogfood 和测试，技术上「完美」的产物（平衡完美的游戏、做得很好的 macOS Dock 应用）最后却没人用。他还用游戏举例：「完全平衡的游戏是无聊的」，石头剪刀布就是例子；主持人用 Claude 模拟数千局自研卡牌游戏后发现模型很不擅长调整系统级平衡。 其他观点：他没有被 token 卡住（两家 200 美元套餐都没用到上限），甚至不觉得被智能卡住，更多是被「野心」和「与模型协作的方式」卡住；认为当前的 harness 低估了 decision model（单次前向传播即可给出决策，适合客服等路由型场…

items.title: Sam Altman · OpenAI CEO
items.summaryEn: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman singled out Ven as one of the earliest believers that OpenAI's then-current model could be used to solve Millennium Prize problems. Plenty of people are brilliant, he wrote, but combining brilliance with correctly-placed confidence and the courage to keep pushing on what others think impossible is rare — and he's grateful so many at OpenAI have it. His other Thanksgiving posts were about family: a quiet evening with his kids is one of the rare repetitive things that keeps getting better.
items.insightZh: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 在感恩节点名一位叫 Ven 的同事：他是最早相信「用当时的模型就能去攻克千禧年大奖难题」的人之一。Altman 认为聪明人很多，但兼具聪明、恰当的自信与坚持推进别人认为不可能之事的勇气，非常稀缺，他很庆幸 OpenAI 有许多这样的人。其余几条是关于家庭与孩子的感恩：和孩子一起度过的平凡夜晚，是少数「重复越多越美好」的事。

items.title: Nan Yu · OpenAI Codex（前 Linear）
items.summaryEn: Nan Yu of OpenAI Codex pushed back on the "beyond chat" narrative: voice chat is chat, sending images is chat, issuing instructions and getting a site back is chat — and you can do all of these in ChatGPT today. The implication: chat as a general interaction container is far broader than critics assume.
items.insightZh: OpenAI Codex 团队的 Nan Yu 对「Chat 已死、要做新交互形态」的论调泼了冷水：语音对话是 chat，往对话里发图是 chat，下指令拿回一个网站也是 chat——这些在 ChatGPT 里现在就都能做。言下之意，chat 作为通用交互容器的边界远比人们以为的宽。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad says Google "really cooked" with Gemini 4 and invited users to try it on Replit, where it is now available.
items.insightZh: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 盛赞 Google 新发布的 Gemini 4「really cooked」，并邀请用户到 Replit 上试用——Gemini 4 已接入 Replit。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder、内容创作者
items.summaryEn: Zara Zhang, who grew 80k X followers in a year, shared 12 tips for people moving from LinkedIn to X. Key points: LinkedIn is a stage, X is a party — find your crowd and listen first; you can't reach the C-suite directly, so earn mass attention first; post far more than you think (she posted 3x/day for 6 months), expecting maybe 1 in 10 to do well and 1 in 50 to go viral; early on, half your posts should be replies, quote tweets and commentary; fix your feed first; write like texting an acquaintance and never use A…
items.insightZh: Zara Zhang 一年在 X 上涨粉 8 万，她给从 LinkedIn 迁到 X 的人 12 条建议，核心几点：LinkedIn 是舞台、X 是派对，先找到圈子、听懂话题再开口；X 无法直接触达高管，要先赢得大众注意力；发帖量要远超你的预期（她曾连续 6 个月每天 3 条），只有 1/10 会表现好、1/50 会爆；起步阶段一半内容应是回复、引用与评论；先「修好」信息流再加入对话；像给熟人发短信一样写，别用 AI 代写回复；把客户、投资人常问的 10 个问题当选题；露脸、多用视频，1000 粉之前别推销公司。结论：人们关注的是人，不是公司。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: FPV Ventures partner Nikunj Kothari shared a side project: last Thanksgiving, worried about forgetting to text people he'd spent significant time with, he had Claude discover that iMessage and WhatsApp are local databases on your computer. It grew into a surprisingly helpful tool; he released the scripts — fully local, no AI — so others can text the people they spent time with this year.
items.insightZh: FPV Ventures 合伙人 Nikunj Kothari 分享了一个小项目：去年感恩节他担心忘了给一年里相处较多的人发问候，结果 Claude 发现 iMessage 和 WhatsApp 其实是电脑上的本地数据库，由此做成了一个实用工具。他开源了这套脚本——完全本地运行、不调用 AI——帮你找出过去一年相处最多的人并给他们发消息。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch said he's thankful for the optimists — something he especially appreciates as an immigrant to America. To define the future and lead the world you need a positive vision; while many people today talk about a future we must blindly accept, he argues we should use our agency to build and project the amazing future we want for our grandchildren.
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 在感恩节表示感谢所有乐观主义者：作为移民，他特别欣赏美国人骨子里的乐观。要定义未来、引领世界，必须对未来有正向愿景；如今很多人把未来说成只能被动接受和屈服的东西，而他认为应该用我们的 agency 去建造并投射我们希望留给子孙的美好未来。
